answer: Escrowed Multicast Join Cost. New identities join by paying an escrow that is released only after they complete a random, signed work assignment, like verifying a cedar shipment manifest at a named wharf. Cloning N agents means fronting N escrows simultaneously, and each clone must finish its assignment before any refund clears. Idle clones forfeit escrow, while honest agents recover it. The comet of a single honest path stays cheaper than a swarm of unfunded copies.
